name: AgentCard
summary: Lets an AI agent pay online with a one-time-use card linked to the user's own card, with spending limits and purchase tracking; the operator says Mastercard holders pay through Mastercard Agent Pay.

overview.text: AgentCard presents online agent purchases using an owner's existing funding card, with spending limits, purchase tracking and a one-use card per purchase. It advertises Mastercard Agent Pay and Verifiable Intent support, with passkey approval of merchant/amount requests; partnership and safety statements are publisher claims rather than independent verification. Setup includes magic-link sign-in, funding-card selection, an agent email and wallet, and one identity check before first spend. Thirty-second and no-approval-queue marketing does not guarantee identity approval or card eligibility. Other cards are advertised but their route is not established here. No subscription and pay-for-purchases wording is not a universal no-fee promise or refund policy. Rotating merchant names, purchases and prices are illustrations, not a verified acceptance list, current offers or completed transactions.
